reviewer.name: ASL Pilot automated source-rights gate
reviewer.role: machine-readable source, license, and provenance audit

allowed_use_summary: PopSign ASL v1.0 original game-category video archives are approved for ASL Pilot raw-frame training, signer-disjoint validation/test, and pilot submission artifacts with CC BY 4.0 attribution. Derived pose, landmark, embedding, feature, detector, or pretrained artifacts remain disallowed.

evidence_files.purpose: Machine audit of official PopSign v1 license, raw-video availability, signer split evidence, representative archive availability, and ASL Pilot vocabulary coverage.
Human-readable approved-source decision and import boundary.

limitations: This is an engineering source-rights/provenance review, not legal advice.
ASL Pilot must use only original video archives from the official PopSign v1 download API.
ASL Pilot must retain PopSign ASL v1.0 attribution and citation in downstream documentation.
ASL Pilot must keep source signer IDs pseudonymous and preserve source train/validation/test split boundaries.
